description: Road Safety Camera Network - Wet-film Camera Locations is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Cameras Save Lives. A number of intersections in the Melbourne and Geelong areas with red-light cameras still use original film processing equipment known as wet-film technology – referred to as fixed analogue road safety cameras in the Road Safety (General) Regulations 2009. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Cameras Save Lives. Its tags are and, locations, police, speed, traffic cameras. It offers 1 resource(s) in XLS. The portal shows 2025-06-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
